title: HomeFlood Review-Delay Addition to the Re-Rate Credit
content:
**Rule.** A HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies re-rate credit carries a review-delay addition. The review counts as completed on the day the re-rate credit is booked. The delay is the number of calendar days from the date Tidemark received the certificate to that day.

| Review completed after receipt | Review-delay addition |
|---|---|
| more than 60 days | 4 percent of the pro rata amount |
| more than 30 days but no more than 60 days | 2 percent of the pro rata amount |
| 30 days or fewer | none |

The addition is a percent of the unrounded pro rata amount and is added to that amount; the re-rate credit is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

The certificate is the one under review: the most recently received Elevation Certificate entry on the policy.

## Boundary cases

| Days from receipt to booking | Addition |
|---|---|
| 30 | none |
| 31 | 2 percent |
| 60 | 2 percent |
| 61 | 4 percent |

*Hypothetical illustration:* a pro rata amount of 214.375 with a 4 percent addition becomes 214.375 plus 8.575, that is 222.95.
